HOOK_TEXT: "Act in 10 minutes" is a trap
SAY: "Act in 10 minutes or your account is closed." Sound familiar?
ON_SCREEN: "Final notice: act now"
BROLL: Mock suspension alert with a countdown on a fake brand
SAY: That's not a deadline. That's a tactic. Urgency shuts down careful thinking.
ON_SCREEN: Pressure is the attack
SAY: The link is just the delivery. The pressure is what makes you click.
SAY: So use a five-minute rule. Pause before acting on anything urgent.
ON_SCREEN: The 5-minute rule
SAY: Then ask: who set this deadline, and can I check it myself?
SAY: Open the official app or site directly. Never the link in the message.
ON_SCREEN: Go direct, not via the link
SAY: Real deadlines survive a five-minute pause. Fake ones don't. Share this with a fast clicker.
TITLE: The 5-minute rule that beats phishing
CAPTION: Urgency is built to switch off your judgment. Pause for five minutes, then verify through the official app or site. What's the most urgent-sounding scam you've seen? #Phishing #CyberAwareness #OnlineSafety
